ops.oldText: 7.7 If any invoice is not paid within ten days of its due date, Customer shall pay Vendor, as liquidated damages and not as a penalty, an amount equal to fifteen percent of the annual Fees for each week the invoice remains unpaid.
ops.newText: 7.7 If any undisputed invoice is not paid within thirty days of its due date, Vendor's sole remedy is simple interest on the overdue amount at the lesser of one percent per month or the maximum rate permitted by Applicable Law, accruing from the due date until payment. Customer owes no liquidated damages, penalty, or similar sum under this Agreement.

input.comment: [Playbook] We removed the 15%-per-week liquidated damages on late payment, as our playbook does not permit liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer, and replaced it with ordinary late-payment interest on undisputed amounts.
input.summary: Delete Customer-payable liquidated damages in 7.7 and substitute simple late-payment interest.
